name: スライドも一発生成。Anthropicが放った新Labs製品「Claude Design」は何を変えるのか
summary: Japanese note article on Anthropic's Claude Design: what conversation-made prototypes, slides and one-pagers change.
description: A note post by suke (September 2026) about Claude Design, the Anthropic Labs product that turns a conversation into prototypes, slides and one-pagers rendered as interactive HTML. It discusses exports, the Canva connection and how the feature sits next to PowerPoint, Canva and Gamma; the first part is free, the rest is paid.
